1.consolidated_definition: Fruto de pocos centímetros de grosor, casi redondo, de color verde amarillo y con pequeñas espinas en la cáscara. Annonaceae, Annona montana.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Fruit of a few centimeters in thickness, almost spherical, with a greenish-yellow color and small spines on the rind. Annonaceae, Annona montana.
